name: Website Checkups
author: Website-Checkups

sections.description:
Take control of your websites and online services performance and availability with our reliable monitoring solutions. Our packages provide real-time insights into the health of your websites and infrastructures. Begin safeguarding your projects today using our WordPress plugin or accessing our secure platform. Choose from a permanently free plan or several cost-efficient packages customizable to your needs.

We monitor a wide range of web services, including:

  • Websites, APIs, and web services with all HTTP request types (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, etc.)
  • Mail servers
  • FTP servers
  • DNS servers
  • Any other web services and servers using PING, TCP, or UDP port connections

Our external monitoring checks include:

  • DNS resolution
  • Response code validation
  • Service uptime and availability tracking
  • Content verification
  • Domain registration status
  • SSL certiticates, encryption and protocols
  • Google Web Risk status
  • DNS blacklists checks for mail server
  • Performance metrics
  • Access credential verification
  • TCP or UDP Port connectivity

You can share the results of our checkups with yourself or others using various notification options. We generate clear, detailed charts that track the availability and performance of the monitored web services over time, accessible even months later.

Almost all features are available in the permanently free subscription. You can therefore use this free subscription for as long as you like to test our services without obligation. For more frequent checkups, additional notification options, or monitoring more services, you can upgrade to other subscription plans. More details.

This WordPress Plugin provides:

  • Management of data, checkups, and notifications
  • Clear reporting and chart visualizations of checkup results
  • Secure data exchange between your WordPress site and our SaaS API

Notifications

Manage your notification recipients and assign them individually for each checkup. If a monitored service goes offline or comes back online, the designated recipients will be notified. Each recipient must consent to notifications and can unsubscribe at any time.

Current notification channels include:

  • E-mail
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Telegram
  • Slack
  • Google Chat
  • Webhook
  • SMS (Short message service)

This list will expand over time

Transmission and use of your data

Website Checkups is a SaaS platform that manages on our server all checkups, notifications, statistics, billings and so on. For more details, visit our Terms and Conditions page.

For instance, data entered for monitoring your websites or services is securely transferred to our servers for regular monitoring, reporting and notifications. Company names, addresses, and similar data are used solely for invoicing purposes.

Your data is exclusively used for:

  • Validation and monitoring of online services
  • Presentation of test results
  • Notifications related to your checkups
  • Invoicing and payment processing
  • Notifications about your user account, such as alerts regarding potential deactivation due to extended periods of inactivity

We do not pass on your data in any form (sale, disclosure, rental, transfer or other communication) to third parties who are not involved in the provision of our services. We assure you that your data will never be used for newsletters, sales calls, advertising, marketing, or any similar purposes. For more information, visit our Privacy Policy page.

You control the data you provide. Mandatory fields in our forms are minimized. Deleting data in the WordPress plugin will also delete it from our API. To remove all data from our servers, simply uninstall the Website Checkup Plugin. Paid subscription data (e.g., invoices) will remain in our accounting system only as long as legally required.
sections.installation: Upload the Website Checkup Plugin to your site, activate it, and fulfill a registration.
sections.faq:
Why do we offer this service?

The availability and performance of websites and services are crucial for businesses and individuals. While larger companies have IT departments with advanced monitoring tools, smaller companies often lack such resources. Even with server-side monitoring, outages may go unnoticed until reported by customers.

Our service ensures regular checks of your websites, webshops, APIs, and similar services, alerting you promptly during outages. Additionally, you’ll receive detailed availability and performance reports over a selected timeframe.

Why choose Website Checkups?

  • No setup or IT knowledge required
    Our monitoring runs entirely from external servers – no installation, no technical setup. Just register, define what you want to monitor, and who should be notified. Done.

  • All-in-one monitoring
    From availability and performance to SSL, domain expiry, blacklists, and Google Web Risk—we check it all. Visual reports and flexible timeframes give you full transparency.

  • Free plan included
    Start with our forever-free plan and monitor up to 4 services at no cost. No trial limits, no pressure.

  • Scalable, affordable plans
    Upgrade anytime with flexible subscriptions starting at just €5/month. Choose your check frequency and billing cycle (monthly to annual).

  • No Unsolicited Marketing
    We don’t send newsletters, make sales calls, or push promotions. We believe in letting our service speak for itself – no pressure, no spam.

I’m interested in one of the paid packages, but I’m hesitant to commit to a long term subscription. Will this project be supported in the long run?

Absolutely! This project is backed by elpix GmbH, a German IT company founded in 2003. With over 20 years of experience working with well-known clients, we have built a solid foundation in the IT industry.

Unlike hobby projects developed by individuals, our plugin is a professionally maintained solution. Although we launched our WordPress plugin in February 2025, we are committed to its long-term development, continuous improvements, and dedicated support for our users. For further information please see Impress page.

Try our free plan for as long as you like – no time limits. When you’re ready to upgrade, we offer flexible subscription options: monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual. The longer the plan, the lower your monthly rate.

Is the maximum number of checkups per subscription fixed?

No, the number of checkups is flexible within your chosen subscription. You can select from different usage options and switch between them at any time.

For example, with the Basic subscription (€10 per month), you can perform up to 6 website checkups per hour. Within this limit, you can choose from 7 different checkup intervals — such as one checkup every 10 minutes or two different checkups every 20 minutes, and so on.

This flexibility allows you to customize the checkup frequency based on your needs.

How long does the free subscription last?

The free subscription is valid for one year and renews automatically, as long as the account remains active. You can continue using it indefinitely by keeping at least one check-up active and accessing its results at least once every three months.

What’s the benefit of upgrading to a paid subscription?

Paid plans offer higher checkup frequency, more notification options (Slack, SMS, etc.), and support for more services. Your account and data remain secure regardless of usage—as long as payments are current.

For more details, please visit our FAQ page.
sections.changelog:
A concise summary of new features, enhancements, and fixes in each release.

1.1.9 (August 29, 2025)

  • Fixed: Plugin assets (CSS, JS, and images) not loading after installation – moved files to proper assets directory
  • Updated Bootstrap, Slick, and Chart.js to the latest stable versions

1.1.8 (July 25, 2025)

  • Added “webhook” as a new notification type
  • Fixed minor display issues

1.1.7 (June 5, 2025)

  • Improved wording across headlines, reports, charts, and status messages
  • Added support for additional authentication types: Bearer, Digest, and NTLM
  • Redesigned checkup detail view and dashboard layout
  • Introduced new doughnut-style charts for visual summaries
  • Various minor bug fixes and overall performance enhancements

1.1.6 (May 8, 2025)

  • Optional fields on the registration page are now hidden by default
  • Support added for resending notification verification requests
  • Minor bug fixes and general improvements

1.1.5 (April 28, 2025)

  • Monitoring added for Mail, FTP, and DNS servers
  • Integrated regular Google Web Risk checks for websites
  • Updated chart visualizations for better readability
  • General usability enhancements

1.1.4 (March 8, 2025)

  • Flexible usage options introduced for checkups; switch between them at any time
  • Scripts cleanup for improved performance

1.1.3 (February 27, 2025)

  • FAQ section added to the readme
  • Minor bug fixes
  • Banner images added for improved UI

1.1.2 (February 26, 2025)

  • Plugin updated to meet WordPress publishing requirements
  • Optimized for faster page load times

1.1.1 (January 19, 2025)

  • Simplified registration process
  • Checkup results page redesigned
  • Resolved several JavaScript errors

1.1.0 (December 19, 2024)

  • Major improvements to user interface and usability
  • Revised graphics with added hourly and daily summaries
  • Additional input fields for checkups
  • TCP and UDP port checks implemented
  • Ping test support added
  • Checkup form split into basic and advanced sections
  • Invoice payment via QR code and direct links enabled

1.0.1 (September 5, 2024)

  • Initial release of our WordPress plugin
